transcript.text:
I can help with that. 'Not working' can mean a few different things, so let's narrow it down safely. First, please check two simple things:
1. Is the microwave plug fully inserted into the wall socket?
2. Is the wall socket switched on (if it has a switch) and is there power to it (try plugging in a lamp)? Once you've done that, tell me exactly what happens when you open the door and press 'Start'. Does the display light up? Do you hear any beeps or clicks? Or is the whole machine completely silent and dark? Please don't try to open the microwave casing yourself; there are high-voltage components inside that can hold a lethal charge even when unplugged.
It's plugged in and the display is on, shows the time. It beeps when I press buttons but nothing starts. Door light comes on too.
From what you have described, the most likely cause is control panel / fascia. Can you tell me whether fascia/selector physically damaged?
Not that I can tell, it looks normal. Just won't start.
From what you have described, the most likely cause is control lock / demo mode. Can you tell me whether a lock/child-lock symbol shown?
Yes, there's a little L or padlock-looking symbol on the display.
From what you have described, the most likely cause is door release button / lever / linkage. Can you tell me whether the button moves but doesn't release the door?
Not sure, I haven't tried the door button. The door opens and closes fine though. What about that L symbol?

I can't confirm what L means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is door interlock / monitor microswitch (electrical start path). With it unplugged, look at the plastic hooks on the edge of the door and the slots they click into, and check the door shuts cleanly — food or grease in the slots can stop them engaging. Was there food / grease in the way (and is it cleaned), is a hook or latch broken, or does it all look fine?
Door shuts fine, no food in the way, nothing looks broken. Can we get back to the L symbol though? Not sure what it means.

That 'L' or padlock symbol almost probably means the Control Lock (or Child Lock) is active. This is a safety feature that stops the microwave from starting even if you press buttons, so it explains why it beeps but won't cook. Please try this to turn it off:
1. Press and hold the 'Stop' or 'Cancel' button for 3 to 5 seconds.
2. Watch the display: does the L/padlock symbol disappear? If the symbol disappears, try starting a cup of water for one minute. If it still won't start after that, we'll look at the door interlock switches next.
Held the Stop button for 3 secs and the L disappeared. It works now, it's heating the water.
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?

candidates: Control lock or settings preventing start (medium)
Internal fault (PCB, door switch, or HV components) (low)
